test.title: Internationalization Test
test.description: This page demonstrates the multi-language functionality of the application.
test.instructionsText: Click the language switcher (flag icon) in the top navigation bar to change the language. All internationalized content will update immediately.

moreSites.title: More Sites
moreSites.subtitle: A curated list of useful resources for academic security research and conference tracking. Click any card to open in a new tab.

bestPaperAwards.title: Best Paper Awards in Computer Science
bestPaperAwards.desc: A long-running collection of best paper awards across 32 computer science conferences since 1996, maintained by Jeff Huang.

ccfddl.title: CCF Conference Deadlines
ccfddl.desc: Tracks upcoming submission deadlines for conferences listed in the CCF recommended catalog, organized by topic and tier.

ccfRecommend.title: CCF Recommended Conferences and Journals
ccfRecommend.desc: An accessible mirror of the China Computer Federation's recommended catalog of international conferences and journals (Tier A/B/C).

connectedPapers.title: Connected Papers
connectedPapers.desc: Visualize related work as an interactive graph: enter a seed paper and explore prior work, derivative work, and similar papers in your field.

wisPaper.title: WisPaper
wisPaper.desc: AI-powered literature search that takes natural-language queries and uses Intent Verification to surface the papers most relevant to your research goal.

csPapers.title: CS Papers
csPapers.desc: A search engine for computer science conference papers (csrankings.org venues, including the security top tier) with fast filtering by venue/year and an open API.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Local preferences saved in your browser

unsupported.title: IndexedDB is not available
unsupported.desc: Your browser does not support IndexedDB, so preferences will use defaults.

settings.privacyNotice: Your preferences are stored locally in this browser's IndexedDB only. We do not use this data to track, identify, or analyze visitors, and nothing is sent to any server.

rememberLanguage.label: Remember language
rememberLanguage.desc: Persist your language choice so it is restored on next visit.

rememberDarkMode.label: Remember dark mode
rememberDarkMode.desc: Persist the light/dark mode toggle so it is restored on next visit.

rememberTheme.label: Remember theme color
rememberTheme.desc: Persist the primary color you pick in the palette panel.

showStatusDots.label: Show status dots
showStatusDots.desc: Toggle the colored indicators on the homepage paper statistics. Default is off for comfort.

llmUrl.label: LLM API Endpoint
llmUrl.desc: Endpoint URL for the large-model service (e.g., https://api.example.com/v1/chat/completions).

llmKey.label: LLM API Key
llmKey.desc: Your API key is only stored locally in this browser.

keywords.label: Preferred keywords
keywords.desc: Words to highlight across titles/abstracts. Add multiple and they will be highlighted with the theme color.
keywords.placeholder: Type a keyword and press Enter

randomSection.label: Daily random sampling
randomSection.desc: Sampling pool and weights for the Daily Random page.

randomSampleCount.label: Daily sample size
randomSampleCount.desc: Number of papers drawn per batch on the Daily Random page.

randomYearsBack.label: Sampling window (years)
randomYearsBack.desc: Only papers from the most recent N years enter the pool.

randomExcludeRead.label: Exclude read papers
randomExcludeRead.desc: Papers marked as read are removed from the daily pool.

randomCategoryWeights.label: Category weights
randomCategoryWeights.desc: Relative draw weight per category (0.5–3.0, default 1.0). Clamped so every paper keeps a floor probability.

randomKeywordBoost.label: Keyword boost
randomKeywordBoost.desc: Weight multiplier when a title matches any preferred keyword (1.0–3.0).
